WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    orders.orderflow,
    AVG(orderexecutions.fillcount) as avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  JOIN orders ON orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault
  WHERE orders.orderflow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orders.orderflow
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_count) as total FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  grouped.orderflow,
  grouped.avg_fillcount,
  grouped.group_count,
  CAST(grouped.group_count AS FLOAT) / totals.total as ratio
FROM grouped, totals
ORDER BY grouped.orderflow
